# Archived workflows

Inherited workflows and the earlier CI/release preparation are retained here as non-executable reference material. They are not GitHub Actions entry points. Their registered workflow IDs are also disabled before repository Actions is enabled for the single manual Pages workflow.

Do not move these back into workflows without reviewing permissions, triggers, repository identities, publishing destinations and secrets. Binary releases are signed locally and published manually for the initial public beta. No PR workflow has access to release credentials.
